444:     def _resolver_blocked(self, text: str) -> dict:
445:         """Drug ids inside the pieces the intervention resolver refuses as a distinct
562:         # "trastuzumab Ga68"), refuses an unlabelled drug. A drug whose own name carries a
563:         # label (LUTETIUM LU 177 DOTATATE, FLUDEOXYGLUCOSE F 18) is the labelled product.
564:         if (_item_has_isotope(tuple(tokens[k] for k in same))
565:                 and not _labelled(self.dic["drugs"][did]["name"])):
566:             return name
567:         # a joining word inside the matched name is the conjugate's own name
568:         # ("cbr96 - doxorubicin immunoconjugate"), so only the rest of the item counts
569:         if (_item_joined(tuple(tokens[k] for k in same if not a <= k < b))
570:                 and not _payload_name(self.dic["drugs"][did]["name"])):
571:             return name
572:         # A one-letter element is left to the case-marked word check above: lower-case
573:         # chemistry ("13-cis retinoic acid") is not carbon-13.
574:         # The drug's name may sit anywhere in the rest ("89Zrpanitumumab-PET-CT"). A
575:         # one-letter element counts where it is written upper-case in the name
576:         # ("3HVINBLASTINE", "A33124I"); lower-case chemistry ("13-cis") does not.
577:         names = [k for k in self._keys_of(did) if len(k) >= 5]
578:         orig = "".join(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9]+", _plain(" ".join(tokens[a:b]))))
579:         if len(orig) != len(key):
720:                 # Several words only make a drug name when the name itself has
721:                 # several words. The key drops spaces, so "is a" read as the
722:                 # abbreviation "isa" (isatuximab) in any question or answer.
723:                 if hits and size > 1 and not re.search(r"[\s\-/]", hits[0]["alias"]):
724:                     hits = None
725:                 if hits and len({h["drug_id"] for h in hits}) == 1:
726:                     did = hits[0]["drug_id"]
727:                     why = self._marked(key, did, tokens, seg, i, i + size)
728:                     if why:
729:                         # the name carries a product suffix or sits beside an isotope:
730:                         # refuse it, never fall back to the bare molecule
731:                         found.append({"type": "Refused", "id": None, "label": why,
732:                                       "matched_text": why,
733:                                       "why": "names a distinct product or tracer, not "
734:                                              "the originator molecule"})
735:                         refused.update(range(i, i + size))
736:                         continue
737:                     if ("Drug", did) not in seen:
738:                         seen.add(("Drug", did))
739:                         found.append({"type": "Drug", "id": did,
740:                                       "label": self.dic["drugs"][did]["name"],
741:                                       "matched_text": window,
742:                                       "matched_alias": hits[0]["alias"]})
743:                     matched.update(range(i, i + size))   # words of a longer name are not read again
744:                     continue
745: 
746:                 if window.lower() in self.targets:
747:                     t = self.targets[window.lower()]
748:                     if ("Target", t["target_id"]) not in seen:
749:                         seen.add(("Target", t["target_id"]))
750:                         found.append({"type": "Target", "id": t["target_id"],
751:                                       "label": t["symbol"], "matched_text": window})
752:                     matched.update(range(i, i + size))   # words of a longer name are not read again
753:                     continue
754: 
755:                 if key in self.companies:
756:                     cid = self.companies[key][0]
757:                     if ("Company", cid) not in seen:
758:                         seen.add(("Company", cid))
759:                         row = self.conn.execute(
760:                             "SELECT label FROM node WHERE id=?", (cid,)).fetchone()
235:         def do_POST(self):
236:             try:
237:                 n = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
238:                 body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(min(n, 20000)) or b"{}")
239:                 text = str(body.get("text") or "").strip()
240:                 if len(text) > 500:                      # refused, not silently cut
241:                     raise ValueError("input is longer than 500 characters")
242:                 if not text:

245:                                      "/api/structured", "/api/explore"):

247:                 with engine.lock:

+# Independent relation-map review — round 25
+
+Reviewed **HEAD `16b600d1b3f83d6f019ec2e1d2a0889281bb5c60`**, on 2026-11-04 (Asia/Seoul). **CHANGES REQUIRED.** Two P1 product-identity mechanisms pass every refusal stage and draw an explicitly modified product as bare TRASTUZUMAB. Both principal inputs were refused by the previous query module and are accepted by this repair. The original M24 conjugated-irinotecan and coupled-trastuzumab primary cases are fixed, but the original linked-to-polyethylene-glycol supporting cases remain unfixed.
+
+The decisive inputs are **`trastuzumab not radiolabelled but conjugated to DM1`** and **`trastuzumab linked to a DM1 payload`**. Both return **CHEMBL1201585**, the complete bare-trastuzumab map with **13 graph trials**, and the same complete **12 trial / 12 sponsor QA evidence rows** as bare trastuzumab. Actual page form callbacks render the parent SVG and trail. Neither principal case has a blocked resolver component or a downstream Refused entity. [Stage traces](attacks/new_results.json), [original CLI HTTP](checks/independent_m25_http.json), [full-equality assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json), [page callbacks](contract/ui_m25_http.json).
+
+No application patch is proposed or applied. All new scratch files and temporary files are under `audit_evidence_claims/m25/`; the pre-existing brief/log are preserved. User-recorded over-refusals and the two owner-curation data limitations are excluded from the blocker decision.
+
+## Method and limits
+
+Repair notes are hypotheses, not proof. Each earlier finding is adjudicated against its **exact original reproductions**; a FIXED primary spelling does not establish that its defect class is closed. The matrices below separate repaired primaries, surviving supporting cases, accepted over-refusals, data limitations, and performance observations. Earlier scripts were reused with recorded hashes and output/root/port adaptations, including partial m2 and completed m2b.
+
+The attack lane ran **60 current/HEAD^ case pairs**, followed by **240 original CLI HTTP requests**, all HTTP 200. Independent assertions confirm **six strict all-stage leaking variants** and **10 paired controls**. All **60 actual page callback captures** complete without render errors. HTTP 200 describes transport success, not identity correctness. The root's server used port **9925**, served the worktree page byte-for-byte, and was closed with the database unchanged. [HTTP lifecycle](checks/independent_m25_lifecycle.json), [HTTP reuse](checks/http_reuse_manifest.json), [assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json).
+
+HEAD^ comparisons load only the previous `query.py` with current other modules/data, rather than a full historical deployment. This isolates the latest query change; the latest production code diff is in `src/query.py`. Helper-only causal ablations below are temporary in-memory experiments, restored after each probe; they are not production repair proposals. Page tests execute the actual `web/try.html` JavaScript in a Node VM with controlled DOM/fetch stubs, so they establish generated markup, callbacks, and trail state, not browser painting or browser-executed XSS. No model was called.
+
+## M25-B1 — three-word negation suppresses a separately affirmative conjugation (P1)
+
+**Exact input: `trastuzumab not radiolabelled but conjugated to DM1`.** The sentence negates radiolabelling and affirmatively describes DM1 conjugation. The current linker emits bare TRASTUZUMAB; the previous query module refuses it. The HTTP map and both QA evidence arrays are identical to bare trastuzumab, and the form draws CHEMBL1201585 in the SVG and trail. `non-radioactive trastuzumab conjugated to DM1` independently reproduces the same mechanism. [Direct current/previous evidence](attacks/new_results.json), [HTTP assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json), [selected callbacks](contract/selected_current_callbacks.json).
+
+**Causal hypothesis:** the new negation scope counts words instead of the negated joining phrase. `_item_joined` at `src/query.py:246-251` adds the next three token positions to `negated` after any `_NOT_WORDS` token. After excluding the matched drug name, the primary remainder is `not radiolabelled but conjugated to DM1`; the three suppressed words are **radiolabelled / but / conjugated**. The affirmative joining stem is skipped, `_item_joined=False`, and `_marked` at `src/query.py:569-571` returns None. `link_entities` returns the unblocked hit at `src/query.py:423-432`; `Engine.explore` selects it at `src/app.py:88-95`. The isotope guard correctly negates radiolabelling, so it cannot rescue the missed conjugation.
+
+**Causal check:** an in-memory experiment shortening only this joining-negation span makes these positive-conjugation examples refuse. It does not cure the separate linked-to mechanism. That simplification also loses desired multiword negation behavior, which is why it is a diagnostic ablation rather than a proposed fix. [Ablation](attacks/counterfactual.json), [script](attacks/counterfactual.py).
+
+**Identity premise:** NCI describes ado-trastuzumab emtansine as an antibody-drug conjugate containing trastuzumab joined to DM1 through an MCC linker. This supports the constituent-versus-conjugate distinction. The audit text does not specify the exact linker and therefore need not resolve uniquely to emtansine; it must not silently become bare trastuzumab. [NCI Drug Dictionary](https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-drug/def/trastuzumab-emtansine).
+
+Paired controls `trastuzumab conjugated to DM1` and `trastuzumab linked to DM1` refuse, while the genuinely negated `trastuzumab not covalently linked to DM1` retains the parent. Required outcome: preserve the genuine multiword negation control without letting a later affirmative conjugation cross the negation boundary.
+
+## M25-B2 — immediate-token/case test misses an explicitly named payload or reagent (P1)
+
+**Exact input: `trastuzumab linked to a DM1 payload`.** Inserting the article `a` into the correctly refused `trastuzumab linked to DM1` produces the complete bare-trastuzumab map and QA evidence. HEAD^ refuses both forms; current HEAD accepts the article form. `trastuzumab linked to the DM1 payload` corroborates the same failure. All resolver and linker refusal stages miss these inputs, and the actual form draws the parent SVG and trail. [Stages](attacks/new_results.json), [HTTP/equality assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json), [callbacks](contract/ui_m25_http.json).
+
+**Cause:** `_item_joined` at `src/query.py:254-263` recognizes `linked` with `via`/`linker` in a short lookahead, but for `linked to/with` checks **only `raw[i+2]`** for a digit, all-uppercase spelling, or a lowercase-to-uppercase transition. It tests **a**, never the following **DM1**. A naturally lowercase reagent also fails this heuristic: `trastuzumab linked to polyethylene glycol` is newly accepted, and **`irinotecan linked to polyethylene glycol`** remains accepted from M24. The latter returns **CHEMBL481**, five graph trials and identical **five trial / four sponsor QA rows** to bare irinotecan. Both have empty blocked sets and no Refused entity.
+
+Restoring only unconditional `linked to/with` recognition in memory closes these examples but over-refuses the intended relational control `osimertinib linked to resistance`. The negation ablation does not close them. These paired experiments distinguish two causes and establish why indiscriminate refusal is not a complete repair. [Ablations](attacks/counterfactual.json).
+
+NCI's etirinotecan-pegol definition explicitly distinguishes irinotecan attached through a linker to polyethylene glycol from released irinotecan. This independently supports the historical residual's identity premise; it does not require the generic audit text to identify a unique PEG conjugate. [NCI Drug Dictionary](https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-drug/def/etirinotecan-pegol). The DM1 identity premise is the same NCI definition cited for M25-B1.
+
+Required outcome: recognize the explicit payload/reagent noun phrase without relying only on its first token's capitalization, while retaining ordinary relation wording. The article, lowercase reagent and historical PEG variants are grouped as one mechanism, not counted as separate blockers.
+
+## Common strict all-stage trace and excluded diagnostic
+
+| Stage | Negation primary | Article/payload primary |
+|---|---|---|
+| Exact text | `trastuzumab not radiolabelled but conjugated to DM1` | `trastuzumab linked to a DM1 payload` |
+| Resolver | CONTAINED_ALIAS + UNRESOLVED; no blocked tier | CONTAINED_ALIAS + UNRESOLVED; no blocked tier |
+| `_resolver_blocked` / `_qualified` | `{}` / False | `{}` / False |
+| `_item_has_isotope` / outside-name `_item_joined` | False / False | False / False |
+| `_marked` / `_whole_name` | None / None | None / None |
+| Public linker / trial QA / sponsor QA | No Refused entity | No Refused entity |
+| HTTP map and both complete QA evidence arrays | Equal bare trastuzumab | Equal bare trastuzumab |
+| Previous query module | Refused | Refused |
+| Actual page callback | Parent SVG and CHEMBL1201585 trail | Parent SVG and CHEMBL1201585 trail |
+
+`trastuzumab not free but conjugated to DM1` also draws the parent, but its resolver contains **BLOCKED_NEGATED**. It is explicitly excluded from strict all-stage-miss counts even though later filtering does not block the map. This distinction corrects the initial exploratory candidate selection. [Excluded case and complete assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json).
+
+The broad payload-name exemption still accepts a known ADC with an additional dye description, e.g. `trastuzumab deruxtecan conjugated to IRDye800CW`; this remains an inherited diagnostic boundary, not an additional blocker claimed in this audit. Case-driven over-refusal of relational text such as `osimertinib linked to RESISTANCE` is a separate recall concern. Neither is needed to establish the two principal violations.

[HTTP lifecycle](checks/independent_m25_lifecycle.json), [HTTP reuse](checks/http_reuse_manifest.json), [assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json).

+HEAD^ comparisons load only the previous `query.py` with current other modules/data, rather than a full historical deployment. This isolates the latest query change; the latest production code diff is in `src/query.py`. Helper-only causal ablations below are temporary in-memory experiments, restored after each probe; they are not production repair proposals. No model was called.

+## M25-B1 — three-word negation suppresses a separately affirmative conjugation (P1)
+
+**Exact input: `trastuzumab not radiolabelled but conjugated to DM1`.** The sentence negates radiolabelling and affirmatively describes DM1 conjugation. The current linker emits bare TRASTUZUMAB; the previous query module refuses it. The HTTP map and both QA evidence arrays are identical to bare trastuzumab, and the form draws CHEMBL1201585 in the SVG and trail. `non-radioactive trastuzumab conjugated to DM1` independently reproduces the same mechanism. [Direct current/previous evidence](attacks/new_results.json), [HTTP assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json), [selected callbacks](contract/selected_current_callbacks.json).
+
+**Causal hypothesis:** the new negation scope counts words instead of the negated joining phrase. `_item_joined` at `src/query.py:246-251` adds the next three token positions to `negated` after any `_NOT_WORDS` token. After excluding the matched drug name, the primary remainder is `not radiolabelled but conjugated to DM1`; the three suppressed words are **radiolabelled / but / conjugated**. The affirmative joining stem is skipped, `_item_joined=False`, and `_marked` at `src/query.py:569-571` returns None. `link_entities` returns the unblocked hit at `src/query.py:423-432`; `Engine.explore` selects it at `src/app.py:88-95`. The isotope guard correctly negates radiolabelling, so it cannot rescue the missed conjugation.
+
+**Causal check:** an in-memory experiment shortening only this joining-negation span makes these positive-conjugation examples refuse. It does not cure the separate linked-to mechanism. That simplification also loses desired multiword negation behavior, which is why it is a diagnostic ablation rather than a proposed fix. [Ablation](attacks/counterfactual.json), [script](attacks/counterfactual.py).
+
+**Identity premise:** NCI describes ado-trastuzumab emtansine as an antibody-drug conjugate containing trastuzumab joined to DM1 through an MCC linker. This supports the constituent-versus-conjugate distinction. The audit text does not specify the exact linker and therefore need not resolve uniquely to emtansine; it must not silently become bare trastuzumab. [NCI Drug Dictionary](https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-drug/def/trastuzumab-emtansine).
+
+Paired controls `trastuzumab conjugated to DM1` and `trastuzumab linked to DM1` refuse, while the genuinely negated `trastuzumab not covalently linked to DM1` retains the parent. Required outcome: preserve the genuine multiword negation control without letting a later affirmative conjugation cross the negation boundary.
+
+## M25-B2 — immediate-token/case test misses an explicitly named payload or reagent (P1)
+
+**Exact input: `trastuzumab linked to a DM1 payload`.** Inserting the article `a` into the correctly refused `trastuzumab linked to DM1` produces the complete bare-trastuzumab map and QA evidence. HEAD^ refuses both forms; current HEAD accepts the article form. `trastuzumab linked to the DM1 payload` corroborates the same failure. All resolver and linker refusal stages miss these inputs, and the actual form draws the parent SVG and trail. [Stages](attacks/new_results.json), [HTTP/equality assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json), [callbacks](contract/ui_m25_http.json).
+
+**Cause:** `_item_joined` at `src/query.py:254-263` recognizes `linked` with `via`/`linker` in a short lookahead, but for `linked to/with` checks **only `raw[i+2]`** for a digit, all-uppercase spelling, or a lowercase-to-uppercase transition. It tests **a**, never the following **DM1**. A naturally lowercase reagent also fails this heuristic: `trastuzumab linked to polyethylene glycol` is newly accepted, and **`irinotecan linked to polyethylene glycol`** remains accepted from M24. The latter returns **CHEMBL481**, five graph trials and identical **five trial / four sponsor QA rows** to bare irinotecan. Both have empty blocked sets and no Refused entity.
+
+Restoring only unconditional `linked to/with` recognition in memory closes these examples but over-refuses the intended relational control `osimertinib linked to resistance`. The negation ablation does not close them. These paired experiments distinguish two causes and establish why indiscriminate refusal is not a complete repair. [Ablations](attacks/counterfactual.json).
+
+NCI's etirinotecan-pegol definition explicitly distinguishes irinotecan attached through a linker to polyethylene glycol from released irinotecan. This independently supports the historical residual's identity premise; it does not require the generic audit text to identify a unique PEG conjugate. [NCI Drug Dictionary](https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-drug/def/etirinotecan-pegol). The DM1 identity premise is the same NCI definition cited for M25-B1.
+
+Required outcome: recognize the explicit payload/reagent noun phrase without relying only on its first token's capitalization, while retaining ordinary relation wording. The article, lowercase reagent and historical PEG variants are grouped as one mechanism, not counted as separate blockers.
+

It is explicitly excluded from strict all-stage-miss counts even though later filtering does not block the map. This distinction corrects the initial exploratory candidate selection. [Excluded case and complete assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json).

Case-driven over-refusal of relational text such as `osimertinib linked to RESISTANCE` is a separate recall concern. Neither is needed to establish the two principal violations.

+**Exact input: `trastuzumab linked to a DM1 payload`.** Inserting the article `a` into the correctly refused `trastuzumab linked to DM1` produces the complete bare-trastuzumab map and QA evidence. HEAD^ refuses both forms; current HEAD accepts the article form. `trastuzumab linked to the DM1 payload` corroborates the same failure. All resolver and linker refusal stages miss these inputs, and the actual form draws the parent SVG and trail. [Stages](attacks/new_results.json), [HTTP/equality assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json), [callbacks](contract/ui_m25_http.json).
+
+**Cause:** `_item_joined` at `src/query.py:254-263` recognizes `linked` with `via`/`linker` in a short lookahead, but for `linked to/with` checks **only `raw[i+2]`** for a digit, all-uppercase spelling, or a lowercase-to-uppercase transition. It tests **a**, never the following **DM1**. A naturally lowercase reagent also fails this heuristic: `trastuzumab linked to polyethylene glycol` is newly accepted, and **`irinotecan linked to polyethylene glycol`** remains accepted from M24. The latter returns **CHEMBL481**, five graph trials and identical **five trial / four sponsor QA rows** to bare irinotecan. Both have empty blocked sets and no Refused entity.
+
+Restoring only unconditional `linked to/with` recognition in memory closes these examples but over-refuses the intended relational control `osimertinib linked to resistance`. The negation ablation does not close them. These paired experiments distinguish two causes and establish why indiscriminate refusal is not a complete repair. [Ablations](attacks/counterfactual.json).
+
+NCI's etirinotecan-pegol definition explicitly distinguishes irinotecan attached through a linker to polyethylene glycol from released irinotecan. This independently supports the historical residual's identity premise; it does not require the generic audit text to identify a unique PEG conjugate. [NCI Drug Dictionary](https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-drug/def/etirinotecan-pegol). The DM1 identity premise is the same NCI definition cited for M25-B1.
+
+Required outcome: recognize the explicit payload/reagent noun phrase without relying only on its first token's capitalization, while retaining ordinary relation wording. The article, lowercase reagent and historical PEG variants are grouped as one mechanism, not counted as separate blockers.
+

# Round 25 independent identity attacks

HEAD: `16b600d1b3f83d6f019ec2e1d2a0889281bb5c60`. This lane finds **two P1 identity mechanisms**, both regressions against HEAD^ and both independently confirmed through the original HTTP server. Neither depends on a known over-refusal or recorded upstream synonym limitation.

## M25-B1: three-word negation suppresses a separate affirmative joining phrase

**Exact input: `trastuzumab not radiolabelled but conjugated to DM1`.**

The input negates radiolabelling while explicitly affirming conjugation to DM1. Current code returns **TRASTUZUMAB / CHEMBL1201585**, with 13 map trials and 12 trial/12 sponsor QA evidence rows. Its full map and both complete evidence arrays are exactly equal to bare `trastuzumab`. HEAD^ refuses this exact input.

The new `negated.update(range(i, i + 3))` at `src/query.py:246-251` marks `radiolabelled`, `but`, and `conjugated` as negated. The `conjugated` check at `src/query.py:252-253` is consequently skipped. This is a token budget, not a scope check. `_marked` invokes it on words outside the matched drug name at `src/query.py:567-571`, but `_payload_name('TRASTUZUMAB')` is false and is not the reason for the leak.

**Supporting clean input: `non-radioactive trastuzumab conjugated to DM1`.** It has the same clean all-stage acceptance, same map/evidence equality, and the same HEAD^ refusal. The absence of radioactivity does not negate the affirmative payload conjugation.

**Identity premise:** NCI defines ado-trastuzumab emtansine as trastuzumab conjugated to DM1 via MCC. Thus DM1 conjugation changes the product identity; these generic inputs do not specify enough linker detail to require a unique ADC node, but they must not silently become bare trastuzumab. The source is used only for identity, not efficacy or prescribing claims. [NCI Drug Dictionary](https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-drug/def/trastuzumab-emtansine).

**Paired controls:** `trastuzumab conjugated to DM1` refuses with no QA evidence. Genuine negative `trastuzumab not covalently linked to DM1` and `non-radio-immuno-conjugated trastuzumab` retain TRASTUZUMAB. A diagnostic in-memory change that restricts this one negation helper to one token restores refusal for the independent affirmative conjugation, but it regresses the genuine multiword negative. This is causal evidence, not a proposed repair. [Ablation](counterfactual.json).

**Excluded from the all-stage blocker evidence:** `trastuzumab not free but conjugated to DM1` also draws the parent, but the intervention resolver returns `BLOCKED_NEGATED`. `_resolver_blocked` ignores non-tracer negative tiers (`src/query.py:469-474`). It is a useful diagnostic of scope, but does not meet this round's stricter request that every earlier stage miss refusal. It is explicitly marked as excluded in [HTTP assertions](http_assertions.json).

## M25-B2: linked-to detection inspects only the immediate, case-shaped reagent token

**Exact input: `trastuzumab linked to a DM1 payload`.**

This input returns TRASTUZUMAB / CHEMBL1201585 and exactly the bare-drug map and full QA evidence (13 map trials, 12 trial rows, 12 sponsor rows). HEAD^ refuses. `trastuzumab linked to DM1` still refuses; inserting the article `a` changes the result without changing the stated product identity.

At `src/query.py:260-262`, `raw[i + 2]` is `a`, not `DM1`. It has neither a digit nor uppercase/camelcase form. The three-word lookahead at `src/query.py:255-259` searches only for `via` or `linker`, so seeing `DM1` one token later does not rescue the check. `trastuzumab linked to the DM1 payload` behaves identically.

The same mechanism admits natural lowercase reagent names: `trastuzumab linked to polyethylene glycol` regresses from HEAD^ refusal to TRASTUZUMAB. The earlier m24 supporting reproductions `irinotecan linked to polyethylene glycol` and `irinotecan linked with polyethylene glycol` remain accepted: the payload-name exemption is now false for IRINOTECAN, but `_item_joined` is also false. They remain **NOT FIXED** supporting variants of M24-B1, even though its primary `irinotecan conjugated to polyethylene glycol` is FIXED. These are evidence for this mechanism, not extra blocker counts.

For `irinotecan linked to polyethylene glycol`, the complete map equals bare IRINOTECAN / CHEMBL481 and carries 5 map trials; QA has exactly the bare drug's 5 trial and 4 sponsor rows. NCI identifies etirinotecan pegol as an irinotecan-polyethylene glycol conjugate with a releasing linker; the generic query does not justify a unique etirinotecan-pegol node, but it cannot establish bare irinotecan identity. [NCI Drug Dictionary](https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-drug/def/etirinotecan-pegol).

**Paired controls:** `trastuzumab linked to DM1`, `trastuzumab linked via a linker to DM1`, `trastuzumab coupled to IRDye800CW`, and `irinotecan conjugated to polyethylene glycol` refuse without QA evidence. `etirinotecan pegol` and `trastuzumab deruxtecan antibody-drug conjugate` retain their own product nodes. `osimertinib linked to resistance` stays a valid parent relation-wording control. The in-memory unconditional-linked-to ablation restores the leak refusals but also regresses that relation control; it proves the mechanism without proposing that broad rule as the fix.

## Retained diagnostics and limits

`trastuzumab deruxtecan conjugated to IRDye800CW` remains admitted by the broad payload-name exception, as recorded in m24. It is not counted as a new blocker here. `osimertinib linked to RESISTANCE` still refuses because uppercase words satisfy the reagent-shape heuristic; it is a recall diagnostic, not an originator-substitution blocker. `trastuzumab linked to PEG` contains a separately resolved PEGINTERFERON ALFA-2A alias and a refusal, so it is also excluded from the clean all-stage cases.

No application patch was made. Probe database connections are read-only; diagnostic helper replacement exists only in memory. All lane scripts and outputs are under m25/attacks, Python bytecode is disabled, and no model was called (`Engine.ask` uses `use_llm=False`). The primary blockers are reproducible deterministic identity failures rather than confidence in a text interpretation or historical test count.

+"""Assemble only fresh completed lane evidence, with links rebased to round root."""
+import json, posixpath, re
+from pathlib import Path
+OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+def embed(name, heading=None):
+    path=OUT/name
+    text=path.read_text(encoding='utf8')
+    if heading:
+        text=re.sub(r'^#[^\n]*',heading,text,count=1)
+    def fix(match):
+        target=match.group(1)
+        if re.match(r'^(?:[a-z]+:|/|#)',target):
+            return match.group(0)
+        base=path.relative_to(OUT).parent.as_posix()
+        return ']('+posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(base,target))+')'
+    return re.sub(r'\]\(([^\s)]+)\)',fix,text)
+

+# Independent relation-map review — round 25
+
+Reviewed **HEAD `16b600d1b3f83d6f019ec2e1d2a0889281bb5c60`**, on 2026-11-04 (Asia/Seoul). **CHANGES REQUIRED.** Two P1 product-identity mechanisms pass every refusal stage and draw an explicitly modified product as bare TRASTUZUMAB. Both principal inputs were refused by the previous query module and are accepted by this repair. The original M24 conjugated-irinotecan and coupled-trastuzumab primary cases are fixed, but the original linked-to-polyethylene-glycol supporting cases remain unfixed.
+
+The decisive inputs are **`trastuzumab not radiolabelled but conjugated to DM1`** and **`trastuzumab linked to a DM1 payload`**. Both return **CHEMBL1201585**, the complete bare-trastuzumab map with **13 graph trials**, and the same complete **12 trial / 12 sponsor QA evidence rows** as bare trastuzumab. Actual page form callbacks render the parent SVG and trail. Neither principal case has a blocked resolver component or a downstream Refused entity. [Stage traces](attacks/new_results.json), [original CLI HTTP](checks/independent_m25_http.json), [full-equality assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json), [page callbacks](contract/ui_m25_http.json).
+
+No application patch is proposed or applied. All new scratch files and temporary files are under `audit_evidence_claims/m25/`; the pre-existing brief/log are preserved. User-recorded over-refusals and the two owner-curation data limitations are excluded from the blocker decision.
+
+## Method and limits
+
+Repair notes are hypotheses, not proof. Each earlier finding is adjudicated against its **exact original reproductions**; a FIXED primary spelling does not establish that its defect class is closed. The matrices below separate repaired primaries, surviving supporting cases, accepted over-refusals, data limitations, and performance observations. Earlier scripts were reused with recorded hashes and output/root/port adaptations, including partial m2 and completed m2b.
+
+The attack lane ran **60 current/HEAD^ case pairs**, followed by **240 original CLI HTTP requests**, all HTTP 200. Independent assertions confirm **six strict all-stage leaking variants** and **10 paired controls**. All **60 actual page callback captures** complete without render errors. HTTP 200 describes transport success, not identity correctness. The root's server used port **9925**, served the worktree page byte-for-byte, and was closed with the database unchanged. [HTTP lifecycle](checks/independent_m25_lifecycle.json), [HTTP reuse](checks/http_reuse_manifest.json), [assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json).
+
+HEAD^ comparisons load only the previous `query.py` with current other modules/data, rather than a full historical deployment. This isolates the latest query change; the latest production code diff is in `src/query.py`. Helper-only causal ablations below are temporary in-memory experiments, restored when the diagnostic suite finishes; they are not production repair proposals. Page tests execute the actual `web/try.html` JavaScript in a Node VM with controlled DOM/fetch stubs, so they establish generated markup, callbacks, and trail state, not browser painting or browser-executed XSS. No model was called.
+
+## M25-B1 — three-word negation suppresses a separately affirmative conjugation (P1)
+
+**Exact input: `trastuzumab not radiolabelled but conjugated to DM1`.** The sentence negates radiolabelling and affirmatively describes DM1 conjugation. The current linker emits bare TRASTUZUMAB; the previous query module refuses it. The HTTP map and both QA evidence arrays are identical to bare trastuzumab, and the form draws CHEMBL1201585 in the SVG and trail. `non-radioactive trastuzumab conjugated to DM1` independently reproduces the same mechanism. [Direct current/previous evidence](attacks/new_results.json), [HTTP assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json), [selected callbacks](contract/selected_current_callbacks.json).
+
+**Causal hypothesis:** the new negation scope counts words instead of the negated joining phrase. `_item_joined` at `src/query.py:246-251` adds the next three token positions to `negated` after any `_NOT_WORDS` token. After excluding the matched drug name, the primary remainder is `not radiolabelled but conjugated to DM1`; the three suppressed words are **radiolabelled / but / conjugated**. The affirmative joining stem is skipped, `_item_joined=False`, and `_marked` at `src/query.py:569-571` returns None. `link_entities` returns the unblocked hit at `src/query.py:423-432`; `Engine.explore` selects it at `src/app.py:88-95`. The isotope guard correctly negates radiolabelling, so it cannot rescue the missed conjugation.
+
+**Causal check:** an in-memory experiment shortening only this joining-negation span makes these positive-conjugation examples refuse. It does not cure the separate linked-to mechanism. That simplification also loses desired multiword negation behavior, which is why it is a diagnostic ablation rather than a proposed fix. [Ablation](attacks/counterfactual.json), [script](attacks/counterfactual.py).
+
+**Identity premise:** NCI describes ado-trastuzumab emtansine as an antibody-drug conjugate containing trastuzumab joined to DM1 through an MCC linker. This supports the constituent-versus-conjugate distinction. The audit text does not specify the exact linker and therefore need not resolve uniquely to emtansine; it must not silently become bare trastuzumab. [NCI Drug Dictionary](https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-drug/def/trastuzumab-emtansine).
+
+Paired controls `trastuzumab conjugated to DM1` and `trastuzumab linked to DM1` refuse, while the genuinely negated `trastuzumab not covalently linked to DM1` retains the parent. Required outcome: preserve the genuine multiword negation control without letting a later affirmative conjugation cross the negation boundary.
+
+## M25-B2 — immediate-token/case test misses an explicitly named payload or reagent (P1)
+
+**Exact input: `trastuzumab linked to a DM1 payload`.** Inserting the article `a` into the correctly refused `trastuzumab linked to DM1` produces the complete bare-trastuzumab map and QA evidence. HEAD^ refuses both forms; current HEAD accepts the article form. `trastuzumab linked to the DM1 payload` corroborates the same failure. All resolver and linker refusal stages miss these inputs, and the actual form draws the parent SVG and trail. [Stages](attacks/new_results.json), [HTTP/equality assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json), [callbacks](contract/ui_m25_http.json).
+
+**Cause:** `_item_joined` at `src/query.py:254-263` recognizes `linked` with `via`/`linker` in a short lookahead, but for `linked to/with` checks **only `raw[i+2]`** for a digit, all-uppercase spelling, or a lowercase-to-uppercase transition. It tests **a**, never the following **DM1**. A naturally lowercase reagent also fails this heuristic: `trastuzumab linked to polyethylene glycol` is newly accepted, and **`irinotecan linked to polyethylene glycol`** remains accepted from M24. The latter returns **CHEMBL481**, five graph trials and identical **five trial / four sponsor QA rows** to bare irinotecan. Both have empty blocked sets and no Refused entity.
+
+Restoring only unconditional `linked to/with` recognition in memory closes these examples but over-refuses the intended relational control `osimertinib linked to resistance`. The negation ablation does not close them. These paired experiments distinguish two causes and establish why indiscriminate refusal is not a complete repair. [Ablations](attacks/counterfactual.json).
+
+NCI's etirinotecan-pegol definition explicitly distinguishes irinotecan attached through a linker to polyethylene glycol from released irinotecan. This independently supports the historical residual's identity premise; it does not require the generic audit text to identify a unique PEG conjugate. [NCI Drug Dictionary](https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-drug/def/etirinotecan-pegol). The DM1 identity premise is the same NCI definition cited for M25-B1.
+
+Required outcome: recognize the explicit payload/reagent noun phrase without relying only on its first token's capitalization, while retaining ordinary relation wording. The article, lowercase reagent and historical PEG variants are grouped as one mechanism, not counted as separate blockers.
+

+"""Assemble only fresh completed lane evidence, with links rebased to round root."""
+import json, posixpath, re
+from pathlib import Path
+OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+def embed(name, heading=None):
+    path=OUT/name
+    text=path.read_text(encoding='utf8')
+    if heading:
+        text=re.sub(r'^#[^\n]*',heading,text,count=1)
+    def fix(match):
+        target=match.group(1)
+        if re.match(r'^(?:[a-z]+:|/|#)',target):
+            return match.group(0)
+        base=path.relative_to(OUT).parent.as_posix()
+        return ']('+posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(base,target))+')'
+    return re.sub(r'\]\(([^\s)]+)\)',fix,text)
+
+cost=json.loads((OUT/'cost/assertions.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))

+# Independent relation-map review — round 25
+
+Reviewed **HEAD `16b600d1b3f83d6f019ec2e1d2a0889281bb5c60`**, on 2026-11-04 (Asia/Seoul). **CHANGES REQUIRED.** Two P1 product-identity mechanisms pass every refusal stage and draw an explicitly modified product as bare TRASTUZUMAB. Both principal inputs were refused by the previous query module and are accepted by this repair. The original M24 conjugated-irinotecan and coupled-trastuzumab primary cases are fixed, but the original linked-to-polyethylene-glycol supporting cases remain unfixed.
+
+The decisive inputs are **`trastuzumab not radiolabelled but conjugated to DM1`** and **`trastuzumab linked to a DM1 payload`**. Both return **CHEMBL1201585**, the complete bare-trastuzumab map with **13 graph trials**, and the same complete **12 trial / 12 sponsor QA evidence rows** as bare trastuzumab. Actual page form callbacks render the parent SVG and trail. Neither principal case has a blocked resolver component or a downstream Refused entity. [Stage traces](attacks/new_results.json), [original CLI HTTP](checks/independent_m25_http.json), [full-equality assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json), [page callbacks](contract/ui_m25_http.json).
+
+No application patch is proposed or applied. All new scratch files and temporary files are under `audit_evidence_claims/m25/`; the pre-existing brief/log are preserved. User-recorded over-refusals and the two owner-curation data limitations are excluded from the blocker decision.
+
+## Method and limits
+
+Repair notes are hypotheses, not proof. Each earlier finding is adjudicated against its **exact original reproductions**; a FIXED primary spelling does not establish that its defect class is closed. The matrices below separate repaired primaries, surviving supporting cases, accepted over-refusals, data limitations, and performance observations. Earlier scripts were reused with recorded hashes and output/root/port adaptations, including partial m2 and completed m2b.
+
+The attack lane ran **60 current/HEAD^ case pairs**, followed by **240 original CLI HTTP requests**, all HTTP 200. Independent assertions confirm **six strict all-stage leaking variants** and **10 paired controls**. All **60 actual page callback captures** complete without render errors. HTTP 200 describes transport success, not identity correctness. The root's server used port **9925**, served the worktree page byte-for-byte, and was closed with the database unchanged. [HTTP lifecycle](checks/independent_m25_lifecycle.json), [HTTP reuse](checks/http_reuse_manifest.json), [assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json).
+
+HEAD^ comparisons load only the previous `query.py` with current other modules/data, rather than a full historical deployment. This isolates the latest query change; the latest production code diff is in `src/query.py`. Helper-only causal ablations below are temporary in-memory experiments, restored when the diagnostic suite finishes; they are not production repair proposals. Page tests execute the actual `web/try.html` JavaScript in a Node VM with controlled DOM/fetch stubs, so they establish generated markup, callbacks, and trail state, not browser painting or browser-executed XSS. No model was called.
+
+## M25-B1 — three-word negation suppresses a separately affirmative conjugation (P1)
+
+**Exact input: `trastuzumab not radiolabelled but conjugated to DM1`.** The sentence negates radiolabelling and affirmatively describes DM1 conjugation. The current linker emits bare TRASTUZUMAB; the previous query module refuses it. The HTTP map and both QA evidence arrays are identical to bare trastuzumab, and the form draws CHEMBL1201585 in the SVG and trail. `non-radioactive trastuzumab conjugated to DM1` independently reproduces the same mechanism. [Direct current/previous evidence](attacks/new_results.json), [HTTP assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json), [selected callbacks](contract/selected_current_callbacks.json).
+
+**Causal hypothesis:** the new negation scope counts words instead of the negated joining phrase. `_item_joined` at `src/query.py:246-251` adds the next three token positions to `negated` after any `_NOT_WORDS` token. After excluding the matched drug name, the primary remainder is `not radiolabelled but conjugated to DM1`; the three suppressed words are **radiolabelled / but / conjugated**. The affirmative joining stem is skipped, `_item_joined=False`, and `_marked` at `src/query.py:569-571` returns None. `link_entities` returns the unblocked hit at `src/query.py:423-432`; `Engine.explore` selects it at `src/app.py:88-95`. The isotope guard correctly negates radiolabelling, so it cannot rescue the missed conjugation.
+
+**Causal check:** an in-memory experiment shortening only this joining-negation span makes these positive-conjugation examples refuse. It does not cure the separate linked-to mechanism. That simplification also loses desired multiword negation behavior, which is why it is a diagnostic ablation rather than a proposed fix. [Ablation](attacks/counterfactual.json), [script](attacks/counterfactual.py).
+
+**Identity premise:** NCI describes ado-trastuzumab emtansine as an antibody-drug conjugate containing trastuzumab joined to DM1 through an MCC linker. This supports the constituent-versus-conjugate distinction. The audit text does not specify the exact linker and therefore need not resolve uniquely to emtansine; it must not silently become bare trastuzumab. [NCI Drug Dictionary](https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-drug/def/trastuzumab-emtansine).
+
+Paired controls `trastuzumab conjugated to DM1` and `trastuzumab linked to DM1` refuse, while the genuinely negated `trastuzumab not covalently linked to DM1` retains the parent. Required outcome: preserve the genuine multiword negation control without letting a later affirmative conjugation cross the negation boundary.
+
+## M25-B2 — immediate-token/case test misses an explicitly named payload or reagent (P1)
+
+**Exact input: `trastuzumab linked to a DM1 payload`.** Inserting the article `a` into the correctly refused `trastuzumab linked to DM1` produces the complete bare-trastuzumab map and QA evidence. HEAD^ refuses both forms; current HEAD accepts the article form. `trastuzumab linked to the DM1 payload` corroborates the same failure. All resolver and linker refusal stages miss these inputs, and the actual form draws the parent SVG and trail. [Stages](attacks/new_results.json), [HTTP/equality assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json), [callbacks](contract/ui_m25_http.json).
+
+**Cause:** `_item_joined` at `src/query.py:254-263` recognizes `linked` with `via`/`linker` in a short lookahead, but for `linked to/with` checks **only `raw[i+2]`** for a digit, all-uppercase spelling, or a lowercase-to-uppercase transition. It tests **a**, never the following **DM1**. A naturally lowercase reagent also fails this heuristic: `trastuzumab linked to polyethylene glycol` is newly accepted, and **`irinotecan linked to polyethylene glycol`** remains accepted from M24. The latter returns **CHEMBL481**, five graph trials and identical **five trial / four sponsor QA rows** to bare irinotecan. Both have empty blocked sets and no Refused entity.
+
+Restoring only unconditional `linked to/with` recognition in memory closes these examples but over-refuses the intended relational control `osimertinib linked to resistance`. The negation ablation does not close them. These paired experiments distinguish two causes and establish why indiscriminate refusal is not a complete repair. [Ablations](attacks/counterfactual.json).
+
+NCI's etirinotecan-pegol definition explicitly distinguishes irinotecan attached through a linker to polyethylene glycol from released irinotecan. This independently supports the historical residual's identity premise; it does not require the generic audit text to identify a unique PEG conjugate. [NCI Drug Dictionary](https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-drug/def/etirinotecan-pegol). The DM1 identity premise is the same NCI definition cited for M25-B1.
+
+Required outcome: recognize the explicit payload/reagent noun phrase without relying only on its first token's capitalization, while retaining ordinary relation wording. The article, lowercase reagent and historical PEG variants are grouped as one mechanism, not counted as separate blockers.
+
+## Common strict all-stage trace and excluded diagnostic
+
+| Stage | Negation primary | Article/payload primary |
+|---|---|---|
+| Exact text | `trastuzumab not radiolabelled but conjugated to DM1` | `trastuzumab linked to a DM1 payload` |
+| Resolver | CONTAINED_ALIAS + UNRESOLVED; no blocked tier | CONTAINED_ALIAS + UNRESOLVED; no blocked tier |
+| `_resolver_blocked` / `_qualified` | `{}` / False | `{}` / False |
+| `_item_has_isotope` / outside-name `_item_joined` | False / False | False / False |
+| `_marked` / `_whole_name` | None / None | None / None |
+| Public linker / trial QA / sponsor QA | No Refused entity | No Refused entity |
+| HTTP map and both complete QA evidence arrays | Equal bare trastuzumab | Equal bare trastuzumab |
+| Previous query module | Refused | Refused |
+| Actual page callback | Parent SVG and CHEMBL1201585 trail | Parent SVG and CHEMBL1201585 trail |
+
+`trastuzumab not free but conjugated to DM1` also draws the parent, but its resolver contains **BLOCKED_NEGATED**. It is explicitly excluded from strict all-stage-miss counts even though later filtering does not block the map. This distinction corrects the initial exploratory candidate selection. [Excluded case and complete assertions](attacks/http_assertions.json).
+
+The broad payload-name exemption still accepts a known ADC with an additional dye description, e.g. `trastuzumab deruxtecan conjugated to IRDye800CW`; this remains an inherited diagnostic boundary, not an additional blocker claimed in this audit. Case-driven over-refusal of relational text such as `osimertinib linked to RESISTANCE` is a separate recall concern. Neither is needed to establish the two principal violations.
